findings.note: MA House, On adoption of amendment #7 (H.4359) - failed, 2022-01-27: yea (tally 32–126); census gate: none.

H.812, 'An Act relative to Massachusetts voter identification law', is described on the legislature's page as a petition of Marc T. Lombardo and Nicholas A. Boldyga 'relative to the identification requirements for certain voters.' The page lists it as referred to the Election Laws committee on 3/29/2021 and accompanied a study order (H5026) on 9/12/2022. The bill text itself did not load on the page, so what it requires is not confirmed here. Boldyga is named as a petitioner (lead petitioner is Lombardo).
Listed as a petitioner (co-sponsor) of H.592, 'An Act requiring photo identification for voting' (filed 2013-01-22).
